representativeSnapshot.kind: production-like disposable database with an organization owner and unrelated-user persona

rowCountQueries: Record current events_v2 and tour_events RLS policies
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: No rows are rewritten; only function schema, security mode, and grants change

execution.resumeStrategy: The guarded schema move and CREATE OR REPLACE wrapper converge on rerun
execution.idempotency: The private implementation is moved once and the public wrapper is replaced idempotently

quarantine.strategy: No tenant data is inferred, backfilled, or quarantined

constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Verify the public RPC is security-invoker, the private implementation is security-definer, anonymous execution is revoked, and an authorized transaction succeeds under authenticated RLS

recovery.rollback: Replace the public wrapper with the prior implementation only if the private execution path cannot be forward-fixed
recovery.forwardFix: Apply a later additive function/grant migration; do not reset or rewrite the database

queries: Run an authorized one-event quick-start transaction and roll it back
Confirm the test batch persisted zero rows after rollback
Verify public/private function security modes and grants
